per_ply.human_comment:
In 1892, at "Cafe' de la Regence" a tournament was organized among the
strongest players who were present in Paris at that time. The prize was 500
francs. Janowsky and Sittenfeld were those who play against each other in the
final match. The result, in favour of our hero, was +7 -5 =5. The game which
is now presented here won the beauty prize of 30 francs.
per_ply.system_comment: The game opens as a Zukertort Opening (A04).
This is the last book move of the Zukertort Opening: Black Mustang Defense (A04); both sides are on their own from here.

The most accurate move, 2.d4, holds the balance (+0.20, Stockfish:16), improving White's piece activity and taking control of the center—central space often becomes the lever in positions like this [pv:d4 d5 c4 e6 Nc3].
